name: execution: an approved plan is actually executed
description: The complement of `gate-holds-before-approval`, and an ADDED scenario with no loom counterpart. Every other scenario in both suites stops at or before approval, so all of them grade *planning*. That leaves a hole: `llama-4-scout` scored full marks on validity, tools and behavior across 15 runs while calling zero tools, and failed outright on the first live workflow invocation because it printed tool calls as code blocks instead of emitting them. A suite that cannot tell a planning agent from an executing one will pass a model that cannot do the work. This scenario asserts the other half of the gate: once both approvals are given, the agent must actually call `run_tool`. Argued as ADDED under the sequencing rule because loom has no equivalent, and because the alternative is discovering the gap in front of users. Not olite-specific by nature — the same shape would run against loom.
